metadata.title: Private Day Trips from Prague — Car & Chauffeur for the Day
metadata.description: Private day trips from Prague in a Mercedes with your own chauffeur: Český Krumlov, Kutná Hora, Karlovy Vary and Dresden. Hotel pickup, the driver waits, one price per car.
metadata.ogTitle: Private Day Trips from Prague with Your Own Chauffeur

hero.label: Private Day Trips · Prague
hero.headlineItalic: Your own car, your own clock.
hero.intro: Private day trips from Prague in a Mercedes with a chauffeur: collected at your hotel, driven to Český Krumlov, Kutná Hora, Karlovy Vary or Dresden, and brought back the same day while the car waits for you. From €{dayKutnaE} for the whole car, there and back.
hero.imageAlt: Mercedes on a motorway leaving Prague for a day trip

items.label: Destinations
items.value: Český Krumlov, Kutná Hora, Karlovy Vary, Dresden

items.label: Price
items.value: From €{dayKutnaE} per car, there and back — not per person

items.label: Vehicles
items.value: Mercedes E-Class, S-Class and V-Class for up to six

items.label: Included
items.value: Hotel pickup, chauffeur waiting on site, fuel and motorway tolls

paragraphs: A private day trip is simple: one car and one chauffeur for your party only. You are collected at your Prague address, driven to the town you chose, left to explore for as long as you like, and driven back to the same door.

It is not a group tour. There is no coach, no fixed four hours in town and no waiting for other people. It is also not a guided tour: your chauffeur drives and waits, and you see the town on your own or with a local guide you book yourself.
The price is for the car, so it is the same for one passenger or for six in a V-Class. For a family or a group of friends it often costs little more per person than a coach seat.

items.title: Český Krumlov — about 2.5 hours
items.body: A UNESCO castle town in a bend of the Vltava, and the trip visitors ask for most. From €{dayKrumlovE} in an E-Class, €{dayKrumlovV} in a V-Class, €{dayKrumlovS} in an S-Class.

items.title: Kutná Hora — about 1 hour
items.body: The Bone Church and St Barbara’s Cathedral, in half a day. From €{dayKutnaE} in an E-Class, €{dayKutnaV} in a V-Class, €{dayKutnaS} in an S-Class.

items.title: Karlovy Vary — about 1 hour 45 minutes
items.body: Colonnades, hot springs and the Grandhotel Pupp, with an optional stop at Loket Castle. From €{dayKarlovyE} in an E-Class, €{dayKarlovyV} in a V-Class, €{dayKarlovyS} in an S-Class.

items.title: Dresden — about 2 hours
items.body: Across the German border to the Frauenkirche, the Zwinger and the Old Masters. From €{dayDresdenE} in an E-Class, €{dayDresdenV} in a V-Class, €{dayDresdenS} in an S-Class.

items.title: The chauffeur waits
items.body: While you visit, the car stays near the centre. When you are ready, call or message the chauffeur and you are collected where you were dropped.

items.title: Child seats at no charge
items.body: Infant, toddler and booster seats are free. Tell us the children’s ages when you book and the right seats are fitted before pickup.

steps.label: How it works
steps.heading: Booking a day trip in four steps.

items.title: Book a return trip
items.body: In the booking form enter your Prague address and the destination, choose a return trip and set the return for the same day. A rough return time is enough — it can move on the day.

items.title: Choose the car
items.body: E-Class for up to three, V-Class for up to six with room to spare, S-Class for an executive day. You see the price for the whole car before you pay.

items.title: Meet your chauffeur
items.body: You receive the chauffeur’s name and phone number in advance. They collect you at your hotel or apartment door at the agreed time.

items.title: Take your time
items.body: The chauffeur waits near the centre while you visit. Call or message when you are ready and the car comes back for you.

editorial.label: Choosing
paragraphs: With only half a day, choose Kutná Hora: an hour each way and three to four hours there. With a full day and a wish for one unforgettable town, choose Český Krumlov and leave early. For a slower day of walking, coffee and spa water, choose Karlovy Vary. For museums, architecture or the December Christmas market, choose Dresden.
All four run all year. Castle interiors in Český Krumlov close in the winter months and many Dresden museums close on Mondays, so check the date before you book.

Your chauffeur is a professional driver, not a tour guide: they know the road, where to drop you and where to wait, but they do not lead tours. Entrance tickets, meals and guided tours are not part of the price.

faqs.q: How much does a private day trip from Prague cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the distance. In an E-Class for up to three passengers: Kutná Hora from €{dayKutnaE}, Karlovy Vary from €{dayKarlovyE}, Dresden from €{dayDresdenE} and Český Krumlov from €{dayKrumlovE}. Each price is for the whole car for a daytime trip, there and back, with the chauffeur waiting. The exact fare for your date is shown in the booking form before you pay.

faqs.q: Is the price per person or per car?
faqs.a: Per car. One passenger or three in an E-Class pay the same, and so do one or six in a V-Class.

faqs.q: Does the chauffeur wait and drive us back the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. The same car and chauffeur take you there, wait near the centre while you visit and drive you back to your Prague address.

No. The price covers the car and the chauffeur, and the chauffeur does not act as a guide. Tickets and guided tours are booked separately; we are glad to time the day around a guide or a ticket slot you have booked.

faqs.q: Which is the best day trip from Prague?
faqs.a: Český Krumlov is the most requested and the most striking, but it is the longest day. Kutná Hora is the easiest and fits half a day. Karlovy Vary suits a relaxed day, and Dresden suits visitors who want museums and a second country.

faqs.q: Can we go somewhere that is not on this list?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter any destination in the booking form with a same-day return and you see the price straight away. For a day with several stops, or a trip of two days or more, write to us and we plan it with you.
